metadata.title: Wesley — Web Developer
metadata.description: Django, Next.js and end-to-end e-commerce. I turn ideas into products that work.

hero.desc: Django, Next.js and end-to-end e-commerce. I turn ideas into products that work — from the backend to the very last frontend animation.

caseStudies.label: Alva Personal Care · Current role
caseStudies.title: Compre Alva — B2B Portal & E-commerce
caseStudies.desc: Complete digital platform for Alva Personal Care retailers, unifying B2B e-commerce, self-service, ticket management and ERP integration into a single ecosystem. I worked mainly on the backend (Django/DRF) and owned the e-commerce module end to end — data modeling, business rules, APIs and integrations.

stats.label: commits in the monorepo (team of 5 devs)
external integrations: Omie, Datafrete, SendGrid, Huggy, Nextags (WhatsApp), CNPJá and Cadê Meu Pedido

highlights: Generic cart/checkout architecture (GenericForeignKey): the same engine powers live shopping, campaigns, promotions and the store without duplication
Full catalog with per-customer price tables, enabled SKUs, media and specifications
Storefront CMS with dynamic blocks configurable from the admin — scheduled banners, sliders, reels, categories, scrolling ticker and “most bought by you”
Promotion engine: coupons, gifts by value and quantity, conditional free shipping and manual per-item discounts
Bidirectional integration with the Omie ERP: electronic invoices, payment slips, idempotent webhooks and batch order approval through a serial queue
Costs and kits: cost synced from Omie via webhook, kit composition with batch recalculation and automatic blocking of products without cost
Help desk with configurable workflows, dynamic fields, @mentions, per-stage e-mail automation and business-day SLAs
NPS and CSAT surveys: WhatsApp invite after delivery or support, configurable reminder cadence, public form and reports with CSV export
Customer onboarding with retail-chain detection via CNPJá, audited approval decisions and dedicated rules for SUFRAMA customers

caseStudies.label: Alva Personal Care · Current role
caseStudies.title: Alva Tools — Sales rep CRM & internal operations
caseStudies.desc: Internal Django application integrated with the Omie ERP, with tools for wholesale, retail reconciliation (Shopify × Bling), logistics and invoicing, plus a new Next.js frontend replacing the legacy screens. I worked mainly on CadU — the lead CRM for sales representatives — from data model to interface, as well as the logistics and reconciliation modules.
highlights: Lead kanban with search, chain and seller filters and CSV export
Sales territory per representative: Brazil and state maps in Leaflet, radius in km per city and an IBGE municipality table with coordinates
Expired leads: an “Awaiting decision” queue for managers, batch decisions (open pool or hand-off to a representative) with territory-based suggestions and e-mail notice
Multiple contacts per company, possible-duplicate detection and representative sign-up with e-mail confirmation
Logistics: idempotent XLSX importer (updates statuses without duplicating orders) and a period-filtered dashboard
API documented in OpenAPI, with a Kubb-generated client and frontend mocks

caseStudies.label: Alva Personal Care · Current role
caseStudies.title: Alva Personal Care — Complete Shopify theme
caseStudies.desc: Custom theme built on Dawn for a Brazilian natural cosmetics brand: from the home page to seasonal campaign pages, cashback program and careers area. Proprietary typography (SeivaDisplay), a metafield system for tags, videos and related products, and reusable components spread across the entire store.

stats.label: Liquid sections and snippets built from scratch
institutional pages with their own template
valid rich results on homepage (Google) — Schema.org built from scratch, 0 errors

highlights: Custom mega menu with hover/click logic and independent submenus
Carousels and banners with start/end date scheduling
Product card with automatic discount badge, metafield-driven swatches and image swap on hover
Product gallery with synced thumbnails and dynamic information
Goal progress bar in the cart (“R$ X to go for the free gift”)
Reels-style video grids with play and mute controls
Structured data (Schema.org) from scratch: Product, BreadcrumbList, ItemList and Organization — 0 errors in the official validator; star ratings, prices and rich results already live on Google Search
Core Web Vitals: diagnosis with CrUX and PageSpeed, two CLS root causes isolated and fixed — lab CLS dropped from 0.15–0.20 to under 0.03 on home, collection and product pages
Performance and accessibility: LCP image preload, deferred GTM, Video.js removed and heading hierarchy fixed
Blue Friday 2026 campaign theme and scheduled carousels reused across the store

caseStudies.label: Alva Group · Current role
caseStudies.title: Good Mood — Shopify E-commerce
caseStudies.desc: Full build of the Good Mood Shopify store — a brand from the same group as Alva Personal Care — starting from Dawn 15.4.1 and turning it into a tailor-made theme: visual identity with proprietary fonts (Seiva Display and Seiva Poster), 100% custom home and institutional pages with editor-configurable sections, a conversion-driven PDP and analytics instrumentation via Google Tag Manager.

stats.label: valid rich results on homepage (Google) — Schema.org built from scratch, 0 errors

highlights: Brand design system: 12 named colors in the global settings and 2,000+ refined lines in base.css
Fully custom home: hero slider, infinite marquee, kit showcases, reels-style video slider and Instagram feed
One-page 'About' with 10 exclusive sections, including the brand timeline
Conversion PDP: benefit blocks, tabs, stock status, size guide modal and Judge.me
Redesigned cart drawer with progress bar and custom-art empty state
Global floating WhatsApp button and restyled FAQ, policy and blog templates
Structured data (Schema.org) from scratch: Product (price detected), BreadcrumbList, ItemList — 0 errors; review snippets and merchant listings already live on Google Search
Kit builder landing page with description, benefits and features per kit
Core Web Vitals audit (CrUX + PageSpeed) with a prioritized action plan for mobile INP

cards.title: Live Alva — Live Shopping
cards.desc: Alva's live commerce platform. I integrated the B2B wholesale lives with Compre Alva (price tiers, safety stock, minimum order and delivery address) and built the B2C checkout as a Shopify Draft Order, with pricing set only on the backend.

cards.title: WRS Tools
cards.desc: Desktop tray app: water and clock-in reminders, time tracking with CSV export, calendar, tasks and reports, in 3 languages and with no account. Started in Electron and was ported to native Rust, with Windows and Linux installers and auto-update.

cards.title: Geladeira Estoque
cards.desc: Shared office fridge tracker: each person has their own stock, checks items out from their phone (QR code included) and borrows from colleagues with approval and balance. Transactional functions and RLS in Postgres, real-time pending requests and PWA.

cards.title: Blue Friday Alva prize draw
cards.desc: Backend for a government-authorized promotion: sign-up from a WordPress landing page, confirmation by WhatsApp code, lucky number generation, drawing of 25 winners based on Brazil's Federal Lottery and an admin panel. Dependency-free PHP 8 and MySQL.

cards.title: PegaBox
cards.desc: Startup concept created at a startup event: smart residential lockers by subscription, tackling last-mile delivery in Brazil. Field research with 90+ respondents and three subscription plans.

cards.title: Tax data enrichment — TIPI
cards.desc: Django pipeline to populate IPI tax rates by matching product NCM codes against the official TIPI table from Brazil's Federal Revenue Service.

about.p1: I'm a developer from Joinville, Brazil, born in November 1996, focused on e-commerce and digital products. I currently work as a full-stack dev at Alva Personal Care, from the database to the pixel: backend architecture in Django, interfaces in Next.js and deep Shopify customizations.
about.p2: I also have experience with WordPress and Tray stores, plus integrations with Bling, Omie and REST APIs in general. In personal projects I explore Rust for desktop apps and Next.js with Supabase.

education.title: Technical degree in Systems Analysis and Development

skills.stack: Omie · Bling · Shopify API · WhatsApp · REST APIs
